snippet.title: ZOMVAC: The Early Build & Inventory Update You’ve Been Waiting For
snippet.description:
Get an exclusive first look at the latest early build of ZOMVAC! In this gameplay video, we showcase the exciting new updates, including a revamped inventory system and brand-new features that bring us one step closer to the full release. Watch as we dive deeper into the haunted hotel’s floors, battle ghost vacuums, and explore what's to come.

👾 Don't forget to like, subscribe, and hit the bell for more updates on ZOMVAC’s journey!
📅 Prototype Demo Coming Halloween 2025 – Stay tuned for more!
